scanNote:
5-UNITNING BIRINCHI BETI (34-bet). Fon - OCH KO'K.

Yuqorida chapda oq harflar bilan 'UNIT 5' (birinchi surat ustida). Chapda katta OCH SARIQ bo'rtma harflar bilan ikki qatorda 'Planning Ahead'. Ostida to'q sariq 'Lead-in'.

OLTITA SURAT, har birida oq yorliq va bo'sh nuqtali joy (A - F):
• A - havoda uchayotgan yashil JIP, orqasida portlash va tutun (kaskadyor sahnasi); raqami '35KA42'
• B - kasalxonada oq xalatdagi erkak yotgan bolani tekshirmoqda; bola qo'lida ayiqcha o'yinchoq
• C - och ko'k kiyimdagi ayol bog'da o'simliklar bilan ishlamoqda
• D - barda jigarrang jiletli, kapalak galstukli yigit shisha ushlab turibdi; orqada ko'plab shishalar
• E - SARIQ HIMOYA KOSTYUMIDAGI odam metall zinapoyadan ko'tarilmoqda
• F - kepkali erkak qurilish tokchasida turib devorni yopishtirmoqda; belida asboblar kamari

CHAP USTUNDA (och ko'k fonda):
1) a) 'Label each picture with the correct job in the list.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: gardener, stuntman, firefighter, barman, doctor, builder.
   b) 'Can you think of any other jobs?'
2) 'Fill in the job from the list in Ex. 1a.' Oltita gap (a - f).
3) 'Choose adjectives from the list to make sentences about the jobs in Ex. 1a as in the example.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: brave, patient, imaginative, strong, friendly, hardworking, caring, careful. Ostida ko'k qiya namuna: 'Gardeners have to be patient, imaginative and careful.'
4) 'In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya namuna dialog (SA, SB).
5) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'You are going to hear three people talking about their plans for the future. Listen and match the people to the job they want to do and the reason why.' Uch ustunli ro'yxat: Ito/Roberto/Natasha | doctor/firefighter/barman | wants to save lives / likes helping sick people / likes meeting people.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '34'.

exercises.instructionEn: Label each picture with the correct job in the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir suratni ro'yxatdagi to'g'ri kasb bilan nomlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI KASB.

  a gardener    - bog'bon
  a stuntman    - kaskadyor
  a firefighter - o't o'chiruvchi
  a barman      - barmen
  a doctor      - shifokor
  a builder     - quruvchi


⚠ 'A STUNTMAN':

  = kaskadyor (kinoda xavfli sahnalarni
  bajaruvchi).
  ⚠ 'a stunt' = xavfli, mahoratli
  harakat.
  ⚠ Ko'pligi: 'stuntMEN'.


⚠ 'A FIREFIGHTER' va 'A FIREMAN':

  ⚠ 'a firefighter' - zamonaviy,
  jinsdan xoli so'z (30-betdagi
  hikoyada ham bor edi).
  ⚠ 'a fireman' - eski shakl
  (28-betdagi 9-mashqda).


⚠ 'A BARMAN' va 'A BARTENDER':

  Britaniyada 'a barman' / 'a barmaid',
  AQShda 'a bartender'.


⚠ 'A BUILDER':

  ⚠ 'to build' = qurmoq
  (build - built - built).
  ⚠ 'a building' = bino.


⚠ E SURATI - QIZIQ HOLAT:

  Sariq himoya kostyumidagi odam -
  bu O'T O'ChIRUVChI (firefighter),
  chunki bunday kostyum kimyoviy
  yong'inlarda ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ Aynan shu surat 2-modul
  muqovasida ham bor edi.


⚠ 'TO LABEL':

  = yorliq qo'ymoq, nomlash.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'labelLED'
  (undosh IKKILANADI).

items.whyUz:
⚠ Kinodagi xavfli sahna - bu KASKADYoR ishi.
⚠ 'a stunt' = xavfli, mahoratli harakat.
⚠ Ko'pligi 'stuntMEN'.

items.hintUz: Oq xalatdagi erkak kasalxonada bolani tekshirmoqda
items.whyUz:
⚠ Oq xalat va kasalxona - SHIFOKOR belgisi.
⚠ 2-mashqda: 'I've always wanted to help SICK
PEOPLE, so I'm going to be a DOCTOR.'

⚠ 'a garden' → 'a gardener' (bog'bon).
⚠ 6-betdagi 1-mashqda Bob ham bog'bon edi.

items.hintUz: Jiletli yigit shisha ushlab turibdi, orqada ko'plab shishalar
Sariq himoya kostyumidagi odam zinapoyadan ko'tarilmoqda
items.whyUz:
⚠ Bunday himoya kostyumi kimyoviy yong'inlarda
ishlatiladi - O'T O'ChIRUVChI.
⚠ Aynan shu surat 2-modul muqovasida ham bor edi.

⚠ Qurilish tokchasi va asboblar kamari -
QURUVChI belgisi.
⚠ 'to build' - noto'g'ri fe'l: build - built -
built.

exercises.instructionEn: Can you think of any other jobs?
exercises.explanationUz:
YANA KASBLAR.

  ⚠ 6 va 10-betlarda ham kasblar bor
  edi: manicurist, businessman,
  florist, secretary, mechanic,
  lawyer, taxi driver, housewife,
  ballet dancer.

  ⚠ Bu yerda ular QAYTA eslatiladi
  va yangilari qo'shiladi.


⚠ 'TO THINK OF':

  = o'ylab topmoq.
  ⚠ 'to think ABOUT' = ... haqida
  o'ylamoq - BOShQA ma'no.


⚠ 'ANY' - SO'ROQ GAPDA:

  'Can you think of ANY other jobs?'
  ⚠ So'roq va inkorda 'any',
  tasdiqda 'some'.


⚠ KASB NOMI OLDIDAN ARTIKL ShART:

  'She is A teacher.'
  ⚠ 'She is teacher' - XATO.
  ⚠ 6-betdagi 2-mashqda ham
  tushuntirilgan edi.

points.en: a teacher, a nurse, an engineer, a pilot, a journalist
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'AN engineer' - unli tovush bilan boshlanadi.
⚠ 'a nurse' - 21-betdagi Harrods matnida ham
bor edi.

points.en: a mechanic, a lawyer, a secretary, a taxi driver
a florist, a manicurist, a businessman, a shop assistant
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a florist' va 'a manicurist' - 6-betdagi
1-mashqda.
⚠ 'a shop assistant' = do'kon sotuvchisi.

points.en: a chef, a waiter, a hairdresser, a photographer
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a chef' - fransuzcha, /ʃef/ deb o'qiladi.
⚠ 'a waiter' - 2-modul muqovasida ham bor edi.

points.en: a police officer, a soldier, a farmer, a scientist
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a police officer' - zamonaviy, jinsdan xoli
so'z ('a policeman' o'rniga).
⚠ 'science' → 'a scientist'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the job from the list in Ex. 1a.
exercises.explanationUz:
SABAB VA KASB.

  ⚠ Har gap qolipi:
     SABAB + so + I'm going to be a KASB


⚠ 'BE GOING TO' - NIYAT:

  "I'm GOING TO BE a doctor."
  = shifokor bo'lmoqchiman.

  ⚠ 'be going to' - OLDINDAN
  o'ylangan NIYaT.
  ⚠ 'will' - shu daqiqada qabul
  qilingan qaror.

  ⚠ Bu - 5-unitning grammatika mavzusi.


⚠ 'SO' - NATIJA BOG'LOVChISI:

  'I like helping people, SO I'm going
   to be a doctor.'
  = ... shuning uchun ...

  ⚠ 'because' esa SABABNI kiritadi:
  "I'm going to be a doctor BECAUSE I
   like helping people."

  ⚠ Ya'ni 'so' va 'because' - qismlarni
  TESKARI tartibda bog'laydi.


⚠ FE'LDAN KEYIN -ING:

  I like MEETING people
  I enjoy DOING dangerous things
  I love LOOKING AFTER plants
  I don't mind WORKING hard

  ⚠ like, enjoy, love, mind, hate -
  hammasidan keyin -ING shakli.
  ⚠ 12-betdagi 2-mashqda o'rganilgan.


⚠ 'TO LOOK AFTER':

  = qaramoq, g'amxo'rlik qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'to look FOR' = qidirmoq
  ⚠ 'to look AT' = qaramoq
  ⚠ Uchalasi BUTUNLAY boshqa ma'noda!


⚠ 'TO SAVE LIVES':

  = hayot saqlab qolmoq.
  ⚠ 'a life' → ko'plikda 'liVES'
  (-fe → -ves).


⚠ 'TO SOCIALISE':

  = odamlar bilan aralashmoq.
  ⚠ 'society' (jamiyat) so'zidan.
  ⚠ 8-betdagi 14-mashqda 'sociable'
  bor edi.

items.sentence: a  I've always wanted to help sick people, so I'm going to be a ___ .
items.uz: Men doim kasal odamlarga yordam berishni xohlaganman, shuning uchun shifokor bo'laman.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'sick people' - SHIFOKOR belgisi.
⚠ "I've always wanted" - PRESENT PERFECT
(7-unit mavzusi).

items.sentence: b  I want to save lives, so I'm going to be a ___ .
items.uz: Men hayot saqlab qolishni xohlayman, shuning uchun o't o'chiruvchi bo'laman.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to save lives' - O'T O'ChIRUVChI belgisi.
⚠ 'a life' → ko'plikda 'liVES'.

items.sentence: c  I like meeting people and socialising, so I'm going to be a ___ .
items.uz: Men odamlar bilan tanishish va aralashishni yoqtiraman, shuning uchun barmen bo'laman.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'meeting people and socialising' - BARMEN
belgisi.
⚠ 'like' dan keyin -ING shakli.

items.sentence: d  I enjoy doing dangerous things, so I'm going to be a ___ .
items.uz: Men xavfli ishlar qilishni yoqtiraman, shuning uchun kaskadyor bo'laman.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'dangerous things' - KASKADYoR belgisi.
⚠ 'to enjoy' dan keyin HAR DOIM -ING.

items.sentence: e  I love looking after plants, so I'm going to be a ___ .
items.uz: Men o'simliklarga qarashni juda yaxshi ko'raman, shuning uchun bog'bon bo'laman.

items.sentence: f  I don't mind working hard, so I'm going to be a ___ .
items.uz: Men qattiq mehnat qilishga qarshi emasman, shuning uchun quruvchi bo'laman.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'working hard' - QURUVChI belgisi.
⚠ "don't mind" dan keyin -ING (12-betdagi
2-mashq).
⚠ 'hard' - RAVISh, o'zgarmaydi ('hardly' -
boshqa ma'no).

exercises.instructionEn: Choose adjectives from the list to make sentences about the jobs in Ex. 1a as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: 1a mashqidagi kasblar haqida gap tuzish uchun ro'yxatdan sifatlar tanlang, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KASB XISLATLARI (job qualities).

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Gardeners HAVE TO BE patient,
   imaginative and careful.'


RO'YXATDAGI SIFATLAR:

  brave        - jasur
  patient      - sabrli
  imaginative  - tasavvuri boy
  strong       - kuchli
  friendly     - samimiy
  hardworking  - mehnatkash
  caring       - g'amxo'r
  careful      - ehtiyotkor


⚠ 'HAVE TO' - ZARURAT:

  'Gardeners HAVE TO BE patient.'
  = bog'bonlar sabrli BO'LIShI KERAK.

  ⚠ 'have to' - TAShQI zarurat
  (ish talabi).
  ⚠ 'must' - IChKI majburiyat
  (o'zi xohlaydi).

  ⚠ Bu 10-unitning grammatika mavzusi.


⚠ KO'PLIKDA GAP:

  'GardenerS have to be ...'
  ⚠ Umumiy gap uchun KO'PLIK
  ishlatiladi va artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
  ⚠ 'A gardener has to be ...' ham
  to'g'ri.


⚠ 'PATIENT' - IKKI MA'NO:

  patient (sifat) = sabrli
  a patient (ot) = bemor

  ⚠ Shifokor mavzusida ikkalasi ham
  uchraydi - ADAShTIRMANG.


⚠ 'CARING' va 'CAREFUL':

  caring = g'amxo'r (odamlarga
     mehribon)
  careful = ehtiyotkor (xato
     qilmaydigan)

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham 'care' so'zidan,
  lekin ma'nosi BOShQA.


⚠ 'HARDWORKING':

  = mehnatkash.
  ⚠ BIRGA yoziladi (ba'zan defis bilan:
  'hard-working').
  ⚠ 'hardly working' - BUTUNLAY teskari:
  'deyarli ishlamaydi'!
exercises.exampleEn: Gardeners have to be patient, imaginative and careful.
exercises.exampleUz: Bog'bonlar sabrli, tasavvuri boy va ehtiyotkor bo'lishi kerak.
modelAnswers: Gardeners have to be patient, imaginative and careful.
Stuntmen have to be brave, strong and careful.
Firefighters have to be brave, strong and caring.
Barmen have to be friendly, patient and hardworking.
Doctors have to be patient, caring and careful.
Builders have to be strong, hardworking and careful.
modelAnswersUz: Bog'bonlar sabrli, tasavvuri boy va ehtiyotkor bo'lishi kerak.
Kaskadyorlar jasur, kuchli va ehtiyotkor bo'lishi kerak.
O't o'chiruvchilar jasur, kuchli va g'amxo'r bo'lishi kerak.
Barmenlar samimiy, sabrli va mehnatkash bo'lishi kerak.
Shifokorlar sabrli, g'amxo'r va ehtiyotkor bo'lishi kerak.
Quruvchilar kuchli, mehnatkash va ehtiyotkor bo'lishi kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  SA: Which job would you most like to
      do?
  SB: I'd like to work as a doctor,
      because I like helping sick
      people. Which job would you most
      like to do?
  SA: I'd like to ...


⚠ 'WOULD YOU LIKE ...?':

  = ... xohlaysizmi?
  ⚠ 'Do you want ...?' dan ancha
  MULOYIM.
  ⚠ Keyin 'to' + fe'l keladi.


⚠ 'MOST' - QAYERDA TURADI:

  'Which job would you MOST like to do?'
  ⚠ 'most' bu yerda RAVISh: 'eng ko'p'.
  ⚠ 'like' fe'lidan OLDIN turadi.


⚠ 'TO WORK AS':

  = ... bo'lib ishlamoq.
  ⚠ Kasb oldidan 'AS' va ARTIKL:
  'work AS A doctor'.
  ⚠ 16-betdagi matnda ham bor edi:
  'I used to work AS A cleaner'.


⚠ 'BECAUSE' - SABAB:

  ⚠ 2-mashqda 'so' (natija) ishlatilgan
  edi, bu yerda 'because' (sabab).
  ⚠ Ikkalasi bir xil fikrni TESKARI
  tartibda ifodalaydi.


⚠ ZANJIRLI SAVOL:

  SB javob berib, KEYIN o'zi savol
  beradi ('Which job would you most
  like to do?').
  ⚠ Bu - suhbatni davom ettirish usuli;
  19-betdagi 6b mashqida ham shunday
  edi.

items.prompt: Qaysi ishni eng ko'p qilishni xohlaysiz?
items.question: Which job would you most like to do?
items.answer: I'd like to work as a doctor, because I like helping sick people.
items.whyUz:
Kitobdagi NAMUNA.

⚠ 'to work AS A doctor' - 'as' va ARTIKL ShART.
⚠ 'because' - SABAB bog'lovchisi.

items.question: Why would you like to be a firefighter?
items.answer: I'd like to be a firefighter, because I want to save lives.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to save lives' - 2-mashqda ham bor edi.
⚠ 'a life' → ko'plikda 'liVES'.

items.question: Would you like to work as a barman?
items.answer: Yes, I would. I like meeting people and socialising.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Qisqa javob: 'Yes, I WOULD.'
⚠ 'like' dan keyin -ING shakli.

items.question: Would you like to be a stuntman?
items.answer: No, I wouldn't. I don't enjoy doing dangerous things.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Qisqa javob: "No, I WOULDN'T."
⚠ 'to enjoy' dan keyin HAR DOIM -ING.

items.question: Why would you like to be a gardener?
items.answer: Because I love looking after plants and I am very patient.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to look AFTER' = qaramoq.
⚠ 'patient' - SIFAT ('sabrli'); 'a patient' -
OT ('bemor').

items.prompt: Quruvchi bo'lish uchun qanday bo'lish kerak?
items.question: What do you have to be to work as a builder?
items.answer: You have to be strong, hardworking and careful.

exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kim qaysi kasbni tanlagani va sababi FAQAT audioda aytiladi.
exercises.instructionEn: You are going to hear three people talking about their plans for the future. Listen and match the people to the job they want to do and the reason why.
exercises.instructionUz: Uch kishi kelajak rejalari haqida gapirayotganini eshitasiz. Tinglang va odamlarni ular xohlagan kasb hamda sababi bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh ODAM, UCh KASB, UCh SABAB.

  * ⚠ Ito qaysi kasbni xohlaydi va nega -
    audiodan
  * ⚠ Roberto qaysi kasbni xohlaydi va
    nega - audiodan
  * ⚠ Natasha qaysi kasbni xohlaydi va
    nega - audiodan


KASBLAR VA SABABLAR:

  doctor      - likes helping sick people
  firefighter - wants to save lives
  barman      - likes meeting people

  ⚠ Sabablar 2-mashqdagi gaplar bilan
  AYNI - shuning uchun kasb va sabab
  juftligi ALLAQAChON ma'lum:
     doctor → helping sick people
     firefighter → save lives
     barman → meeting people

  ⚠ Faqat KIM qaysi kasbni tanlagani
  audiodan bilinadi.


⚠ 'YOU ARE GOING TO HEAR':

  = eshitasiz.
  ⚠ 'be going to' - REJA yoki oldindan
  ma'lum ish.
  ⚠ Bu - 5-unitning grammatika mavzusi
  va u AYNAN topshiriq matnida
  ishlatilgan.


⚠ 'PLANS FOR THE FUTURE':

  = kelajak rejalari.
  ⚠ 'a plan FOR sth' - predlog 'for'.
  ⚠ 'the future' - HAR DOIM 'the' bilan.


⚠ 'THE REASON WHY':

  = sababi.
  ⚠ 'the reason why' - turg'un birikma
  (ba'zan 'why' tushirib qoldiriladi:
  'the reason for').

points.en: Ito - ⚠ the job and reason are only given on the recording
points.uz: Ito - ⚠ kasbi va sababi faqat audioda
points.noteUz:
⚠ Javob faqat AUDIODA.
⚠ Kasb va sabab juftligi esa 2-mashqdan ma'lum.

points.en: Roberto - ⚠ the job and reason are only given on the recording
points.uz: Roberto - ⚠ kasbi va sababi faqat audioda

points.en: Natasha - ⚠ the job and reason are only given on the recording
points.uz: Natasha - ⚠ kasbi va sababi faqat audioda
shifokor - kasal odamlarga yordam berishni yoqtiradi
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu juftlik 2-mashqning 'a' gapidan ANIQ.
⚠ Faqat KIM tanlagani audiodan bilinadi.

patterns.formula: I like [-ING], so I'm going to be a [kasb].
patterns.exampleEn: I like meeting people, so I'm going to be a barman.
patterns.exampleUz: Odamlar bilan tanishishni yoqtiraman, shuning uchun barmen bo'laman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'so' - NATIJA bog'lovchisi.
⚠ 'be going to' - oldindan o'ylangan NIYaT.

patterns.exampleEn: Gardeners have to be patient, imaginative and careful.
patterns.exampleUz: Bog'bonlar sabrli, tasavvuri boy va ehtiyotkor bo'lishi kerak.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'have to' = zarurat.
⚠ Umumiy gap uchun KO'PLIK va ARTIKLSIZ.

patterns.formula: Which job would you most like to do? - I'd like to work as a [kasb].
patterns.exampleEn: Which job would you most like to do? - I'd like to work as a doctor.
patterns.exampleUz: Qaysi ishni eng ko'p qilishni xohlaysiz? - Shifokor bo'lib ishlashni xohlardim.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'would like' - 'want' dan MULOYIM.
⚠ 'to work AS A doctor' - 'as' va artikl ShART.

patterns.formula: I'd like to be a [kasb], because I [sabab].
patterns.exampleEn: I'd like to be a firefighter, because I want to save lives.
patterns.exampleUz: O't o'chiruvchi bo'lishni xohlardim, chunki hayot saqlab qolishni istayman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'because' - SABAB bog'lovchisi.
⚠ 'so' bilan bir xil fikr, lekin TESKARI
tartibda.

groups.explanationUz: 3-mashqda 'caring' va 'careful' - IKKALASI ham 'care' dan, lekin ma'nosi BOShQA.
